description: Show what a PDF reveals about itself: Title, Author, Subject, Keywords, Creator, Producer, creation/modification dates (with time zone), custom info fields, XMP metadata (size, edit history, creator) and the document ID. Optionally returns the XMP XML. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/pdf-metadata/

file.description: The PDF: a local file path (absolute, or relative to the server's --root) or base64 data (raw or a data: URI).

includeXmp.description: Also return the decoded XMP XML.

name: pdf_metadata_read
title: Read PDF metadata
